title: Chapter 329 Thunderous
content:
Chapter 329 Thunderous

Wana Town's generals took the lead in launching the attack, followed by Lin Dabiao.

This fierce senior general was not afraid at all and went straight up.

But the difference in strength was still quite large.

He was kicked away by the Thunder Skeleton King and fell 11 meters away.

Wang Shuo couldn't help but admire this strong man in his heart. He was a big man, but he was really brave.

He watched his health drop by four-fifths.

After being repelled by the Thunder Skeleton King, Wang Shuo came directly to him and gave him a drop of water of life.

Turning around, Wang Shuo rushed up again.

At the same time, near the East Gate.

Sauron fought a spider-shaped general alone.

His six top generals dealt with another ape-like general.

If you stand on the top of the gate tower and overlook the entire battlefield.

There are undead fighting humans everywhere.

Near the West Gate, Zhao Bangde's opponent is also a human-shaped skeleton general.

He punched the skeleton warrior and sent him flying. One of the sternums on the skeleton warrior's chest was broken, and three more were cracked.

The skeleton warrior roared, and another alien skeleton next to him joined the battle against Zhao Bangde.

Zhao Bangde fought one against two, and he was also at ease, not at all at a disadvantage.

At the same time, he still had the energy to check the battles in other places and take a general view.

Although the general was delayed, the top-level skeletons started to slaughter the human soldiers.

The human soldiers were no match at all. If it weren't for the army of Shanhai City, which resisted most of the undead warriors.

I'm afraid the battle would have become one-sided.

Just when the battle was confusing, a team of undead warriors, about 50 people, appeared at the East City Gate.

They rushed straight to the city gate.

At this time, the soldiers guarding the city had no way to stop them.

Every high-end combat force has already found an opponent, but this group of undead warriors have a clear goal and will never fight.

Finally, they killed to the bottom of the city gate.

Pulled the bolt of the city gate.

A small commander of Shanhai City saw this scene, his eyes widened, his face full of despair.

"The city gate is open."

He exhausted his last strength and shouted.

Then, he was stabbed in the chest by the skeleton warrior. He slowly fell to the ground, his eyes still wide open.

Died with eyes open.

A large number of skeleton warriors rushed into Shanhai City from the city wall.

The city was broken...

Shanhai City was broken...

Hearing the shouts, some lords who came to support quietly killed in the direction of the teleportation array.

But the teleportation array is the top priority at this time, and Shanhai City has sent heavy troops to guard it.

"Anyone who dares to approach will be killed without mercy."

Wang Shuo was also unsure at this time.

Is it really going to be defeated?

No matter what, first kill the Thunder Skeleton King in front of you.

With the combined efforts of everyone, after several generals replenished the water of life once or twice, the Thunder Skeleton King's health finally dropped below half.

This gave Wang Shuo great confidence.

"Everyone work harder, we can defeat him."

Wang Shuo just finished speaking.

The Thunder Skeleton King snorted coldly and said contemptuously: "Just you?"

"Thunderbolt."

He roared again in a hoarse voice.

Wang Shuo was shocked when he heard it.

"Everyone be careful, the boss is going to use a big move."

I saw the Thunder Skeleton King, his whole body was shining with lightning, and the dazzling lightning light quickly expanded, and then shrank into a thunder ball again, condensing in his hands.

He held the thunder ball with both hands and was about to throw it at everyone.

Wang Shuo's breathing was rapid, and his pupils shrank sharply.

This is definitely a taboo big move.

Wang Shuo immediately handed the only resurrection coin to Gong Zheng at the fastest speed.
